The only backend, openai/fixture-model (chain[0], host: config), rejected the request with HTTP 401 (fixture authentication failure). review-call.mjs exited 7. Broken credentials are a configuration fault, not an outage, so the review must not pass silently: it is handed to a human and not retried with the same credentials.
